# Ultha (ultha.co)

> Ultha Moktan does customer research for founder-led B2B AI startups. AI research gives everyone the same answers; she talks to a startup's customers (won, stalled and lost) and finds the patterns, so founders get a clear direction for sales and marketing: what to focus on, who to target and what to say.

About: Former product manager and co-founder of a marketing agency that worked with 40+ brands. Customer research she ran led to +34% and +17% feature adoption. Based in Santa Barbara, CA. Contact: ultha@ultha.co.

## Services and prices
- Why They Buy sprint, $9,500, 4 weeks (founding rate $5,500 for the first 5 clients, in exchange for a named case study): 10-15 interviews with won, stalled and lost buyers; findings report and one-page summary; positioning and messaging fix sheet; quote bank; 1-hour decision workshop; check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days. The founder makes warm intros; Ultha handles scheduling, interviews and analysis.
- Won, Lost, Left, $3,000/month (founding: $2,500/month for the first 3 months): 4 interviews a month with customers who bought, stalled or left, a monthly working session, and updated direction on ICP, priorities and messaging. 3-month minimum.
- Something custom (for example a homepage rewrite or a different mix of calls): scoped on request. https://ultha.co/pricing#custom
- Free homepage review: send a homepage, get a short review post. https://ultha.co/#review

## Who it's for
Founder-led B2B software startups, mostly AI, with real customers (about 40 people who decided in the last six months) and nobody owning customer research yet. Common problems: "everyone said yes and nobody bought", "we sound like every other AI tool", lost deals that give polite excuses, churned customers who don't reply.

## Methods
Customer interviews, win-loss interviews, churn interviews, jobs-to-be-done (switch) questions, voice-of-customer research, building an ideal customer profile (ICP) from best customers. Calls are confidential; quotes are anonymized unless a customer agrees.

## Pages
- [Home](https://ultha.co/): what she does, how it works, about, FAQ and the contact form.
- [Field Notes](https://ultha.co/field-notes): free newsletter from customer research for B2B AI founders: real examples of homepages, messaging and strategy, with clear fixes.
- [Pricing](https://ultha.co/pricing): the Why They Buy sprint, Won, Lost, Left, and custom work.
- [Sample review: why customers buy Attio](https://ultha.co/sample-review): what Attio's homepage says vs. what public reviews say, where they don't match, and what to test. Built from public reviews, not client work.
- [Q1 planning](https://ultha.co/q1): go into Q1 knowing why customers buy. Founding rate for the first 5 clients.
